start.title: Hijos de la tierra
start.text:
Eres Caín, primogénito de Adán.
Tu hermano Abel camina a tu lado al amanecer.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] He smiles. The morning feels lighter.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Compare yourself to him in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] A quiet bitterness takes root.
[TODO:es] He calls your name. You do not turn.

fields.title: El labrador de la tierra
fields.text:
La tierra resiste tu azada.
Sudor. Piedras. Las largas horas de trabajo.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The labor settles your heart.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Curse the ground as you dig
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Each strike grows angrier than the last.

abel_pasture.title: El rebaño de tu hermano
abel_pasture.text:
Abel descansa entre sus ovejas, contento.
Un cordero recién nacido duerme sobre su pecho.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Be glad for his gentle work
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Warmth rises where envy could have grown.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Resent that his work seems easy
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your jaw tightens. Comparison poisons the day.
[TODO:es] Your words stay quiet, but they sting your own soul.

offerings.title: Ante el altar
offerings.text:
Es hora de llevar una ofrenda al Señor.
¿Qué le darás?

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You choose the finest grain. Your heart is open.
[TODO:es] Wilted stalks. Half a thought toward heaven.
[TODO:es] Empty hands. A harder, prouder heart.

accepted.title: El favor del Señor
accepted.text:
El Señor recibe con alegría el cordero de Abel.
Tu ofrenda — Él no la mira.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You ask why. The answer is already in you.
[TODO:es] Heat floods your chest. He becomes your enemy.
[TODO:es] Your fist rises. The sky does not answer.

anger.title: ¿Por qué estás enojado?
anger.text:
Tu rostro se ensombrece. Tus manos tiemblan.
El Señor pregunta: "¿Por qué estás enojado?"

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lay your anger down before Him
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The fire begins to cool. Honesty opens a path.
[TODO:es] You hide your face. He still sees.

warning.title: El pecado acecha a la puerta
warning.text:
"El pecado está agazapado a tu puerta.
Su deseo es dominarte — pero tú debes dominarlo a él."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You exhale. You will choose differently.
[TODO:es] You open the door wide. Sin walks in.
[TODO:es] The warning fades. The hatred remains.

invitation.title: Ven conmigo al campo
invitation.text:
Abel camina hacia ti, confiado.
Su rostro es abierto. El tuyo no.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Tell him the truth of your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Words are hard. But honesty is mercy.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lure him alone into the field
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your voice is calm. Your intent is not.

field.title: En el campo
field.text:
El campo está vacío. Nadie te verá.
La ira te invade. Tienes una piedra en la mano.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] It falls heavy at your feet. You breathe again.
[TODO:es] One blow. Then silence. Then horror.
[TODO:es] Your hand obeys the rage. The field receives him.

confrontation.title: «¿Dónde está tu hermano?»
confrontation.text:
La voz del Señor te encuentra.
«¿Dónde está tu hermano Abel?»

choices.text: [TODO:es] Confess what your hands have done
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The truth crushes you. And begins to free you.
[TODO:es] The lie tastes like ash in your mouth.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stay silent and hide your eyes
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His blood cries out from the ground.

wanderer.title: Al este del Edén, marcado
wanderer.text:
El Señor te pone una marca para protegerte.
Debes vagar lejos de casa.
